entry.title: MPC USB audio 1.0.3
entry.summary: ## What's new in 1.0.3 - **Addins load again after a reboot** ([#2](https://github.com/jacob-sabella/mpc-addin-usb-audio/issues/2)). On units where `/etc` is an overlay mounted during boot, MPC used to start without its addins until you ran the installer again. The installer now adds a small boot step that reloads systemd once `/etc` is mounted, before MPC starts. It only runs when the addins drop-in is there, and uninstalling the last addin removes it. entry.title: MPC USB audio 1.0.2
entry.summary: ## What's new in 1.0.2 - **Works on MockbaMod without manual steps.** MockbaMod starts MPC with its own preload list, so the addin used to install fine but never load. The installer now spots a MockbaMod card, adds an `AddOns/` hook that puts the addin on that list at every boot, and adds it right away. entry.title: MPC USB audio 1.0.1
entry.summary: ## What's new in 1.0.1 - **Models whose audio is a USB device.** With `tap_card=auto`, when there is no `/dev/snd/by-path/platform-sound`, the addin now uses the first sound card MPC opens (never a USB gadget's own card) and logs `codec card N: the first card MPC opened`. Before, it found no card and tapped nothing. Devices with the platform codec, like the Key 37, are unchanged.
